# Summonpot

> Summonpot modernizes APIs for the AI era with one simple contract: deterministic, application-owned operations and bounded agent-owned decisions.

## Install

Requires Python 3.11 through 3.14. Install serving support with:

```sh
pip install "summonpot[serve]"
```

## Quick start

The [quick-start guide](https://summonpot.modepot.io/quick-start/) defines a typed endpoint, serves it over HTTP, and calls it without a provider key by using the keyless test model.

## Primary resources

- [Overview](https://summonpot.modepot.io/): product position, shipped capabilities, and ModePot attribution.
- [Quick start](https://summonpot.modepot.io/quick-start/): install, declare, serve, and call a typed endpoint.
- [Architecture and safety](https://summonpot.modepot.io/architecture/): contract boundaries, authority, runtime behavior, and limitations.
- [Capabilities](https://summonpot.modepot.io/capabilities/): exact operations and explicit agent choices.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/tugrulguner/summonpot): source, README, roadmap, and release history.
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/summonpot/): published Python distributions and release metadata.
- [ModePot](https://modepot.io/): return to the open-source project family.

## Boundaries and license

- The agent owns decisions only where an endpoint declaration explicitly grants authority.
- Exact application behavior remains application-owned and output is validated locally.
- Only a narrow, fully resolved single-operation deterministic slice is shipped; broader multi-operation deterministic execution is planned.
- Summonpot is alpha software.
- License: MIT.
